title: Play animated GIFs
line: Animated GIFs in the Media Frame widget now play, on the desktop as well as in a panel popup.
explanation: The Media Frame showed every file with a plain Image, which only ever displays the first frame of a GIF. Simply switching to AnimatedImage (as suggested in the thread) doesn't work: AnimatedImage passes sourceSize straight to QMovie as a scaled size, and on the desktop the widget is created at 0x0, so the bound sourceSize is empty and QMovie can't decode any frame. That is why it 'only played in popups', and with Qt 6.12 it even recurses until plasmashell crashes at login. AnimatedImage would also load photos synchronously, ignore EXIF rotation and stretch them to sourceSize. Each of the two crossfading slots is now a small component that keeps the Image for still pictures and, when the Image reports more than one frame, shows the file with an AnimatedImage instead (no sourceSize, scaled by the scene).

commits.message:
applets/mediaframe: play animated images

Animated GIFs only showed their first frame because the frame used a
plain Image. Animated files are now shown with an AnimatedImage, while
still images keep the Image so they load in a thread and are downscaled.

BUG: 488075

patches.diff:
From 824bb9bc7b1789e204b06a66bf8f88d1e1a31987 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:14:01 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/mediaframe: play animated images

Animated GIFs only showed their first frame because the frame used a
plain Image. Animated files are now shown with an AnimatedImage, while
still images keep the Image so they load in a thread and are downscaled.

BUG: 488075
---
 applets/mediaframe/qml/main.qml | 59 +++++++++++++++++++++------------
 1 file changed, 37 insertions(+), 22 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/mediaframe/qml/main.qml b/applets/mediaframe/qml/main.qml
index 8d2f4ee52..db9d545ed 100644
--- a/applets/mediaframe/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/mediaframe/qml/main.qml
@@ -187,8 +187,41 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     fullRepresentation: DropArea {
         id: fullRepresentation
 
-        property Image frontImage: image1
-        property Image bufferImage: image2
+        property MediaImage frontImage: image1
+        property MediaImage bufferImage: image2
+
+        // AnimatedImage can't load in a thread, apply EXIF rotation or keep the
+        // aspect ratio when given a sourceSize, so only use it for animations
+        component MediaImage: Item {
+            id: mediaImage
+
+            property alias source: stillImage.source
+            property alias sourceSize: stillImage.sourceSize
+            readonly property bool animated: stillImage.frameCount > 1
+
+            Image {
+                id: stillImage
+
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                visible: !mediaImage.animated
+                fillMode: Plasmoid.configuration.fillMode
+
+                cache: false
+
+                asynchronous: true
+                autoTransform: true
+
+                sourceSize.width: width
+                sourceSize.height: height
+            }
+
+            AnimatedImage {
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                visible: mediaImage.animated
+                fillMode: Plasmoid.configuration.fillMode
+                source: mediaImage.animated ? mediaImage.source : ""
+            }
+        }
 
         onDropped: event => {
             if (event.hasUrls) {
@@ -215,48 +248,30 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             }
         }
 
-        Image {
+        MediaImage {
             id: image2
 
             anchors.fill: parent
             z: image2 === fullRepresentation.frontImage
-            fillMode: Plasmoid.configuration.fillMode
 
             visible: main.hasItems
             opacity: 0
 
-            cache: false
-
-            asynchronous: true
-            autoTransform: true
-
             onWidthChanged: imageReloadTimer.restart()
             onHeightChanged: imageReloadTimer.restart()
-
-            sourceSize.width: width
-            sourceSize.height: height
         }
 
-        Image {
+        MediaImage {
             id: image1
 
             anchors.fill: parent
             z: image2 === fullRepresentation.frontImage
-            fillMode: Plasmoid.configuration.fillMode
 
             visible: main.hasItems
 
-            cache: false
-
-            asynchronous: true
-            autoTransform: true
-
             onWidthChanged: imageReloadTimer.restart()
             onHeightChanged: imageReloadTimer.restart()
 
-            sourceSize.width: width
-            sourceSize.height: height
-
             HoverHandler {
                 enabled: Plasmoid.configuration.leftClickOpenImage
                 cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
--

media.caption: Media Frame on the desktop showing a 4-frame GIF (red 1, green 2, blue 3, yellow 4): stuck on frame 1
Same widget and GIF with the fix: it plays 1-2-3-4 in a loop
Folder slideshow (animated GIF, EXIF-rotated photo, transparent animated GIF): both GIFs are frozen
Same slideshow with the fix: both GIFs play, the photo is still shown upright, crossfades work, no frozen frame under the transparent GIF
